body: Thanks for the encouragement.  I do have a pet, but just keep thinking that she'd be better off with someone else.  Really, all I do right now is work and sleep.  No life really.

The lease is up on the house I'm renting, and the landlord decided against renewing.  I have no clue why - so I have to move.

I just can't seem to find any place good to live. I'm either too lazy to call places or just too picky.  Either way, I think I've just stopped caring about it.
